newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ C 194 of June 25, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ C 194 of June 25, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
Authorization for State aid pursuant to Articles 92 and 93 of the EC Treaty Cases where the Commission raises no objections (97/C 194/10)
Notice of the expiry of certain anti-dumping measures (97/C 194/08)
Communication of Decisions under sundry tendering procedures in agriculture (milk and milk products) (97/C 194/07)
Communication of Decisions under sundry tendering procedures in agriculture (milk and milk products) (97/C 194/06)

Standing invitation to tender pursuant to Commission Regulation (EEC) No 570/88 of 16 February 1988 on the sale of butter at reduced prices and the granting of aid for butter and concentrated butter for use in the manufacture of pastry products, ice-cream and other foodstuffs (97/C 194/05)
COUNCIL RESOLUTION of 17 June 1997 on the development of telematics in road transport, in particular with respect to electronic fee collection (97/C 194/03)
DECISION OF THE REPRESENTATIVES OF THE GOVERNMENTS OF THE MEMBER STATES of 2 June 1997 determining the seat of the European Monitoring Centre on Racism and Xenophobia (97/C 194/02)
COUNCIL DECISION of 9 June 1997 appointing members and alternate members of the Advisory Committee on Freedom of Movement for Workers (97/C 194/01) END OF DOCUMENT.
